definitions.aggregation: Five seed metrics within each fold; equal mean and sample SD across five fold means.
definitions.ft_minus_lr: FT seed mean minus the single common LR fit within fold.
definitions.ft_minus_sgd: Paired matching-seed differences, averaged within fold.
definitions.metrics: six-class macro and class precision, recall and F1; undefined precision is zero
definitions.selection: Earliest highest validation macro recall among updated epochs; all fifty epochs run.
definitions.training_counters: Successful updates, AMP skips and example presentations cover the full fifty epochs.
definitions.units: Scores are fractions; FT minus reference differences are percentage points.

limitations: Expert-map agreement; independent geological accuracy remains unmeasured.
Overlapping training populations; seed and fold SD are descriptive.
Recipe differences include optimization, regularization, batching, precision, budget and selection.
These contrasts do not isolate unfreezing or pretraining. RandomInit has no adaptation arm.
